name: WebDAV
tagline: A web-based file sharing and management protocol
description: WebDAV is a web-based protocol that allows you to share and manage files over the internet, providing a collaborative environment for file editing and versioning.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  webdav:
    cpu_shares: 90
    command: []
    container_name: webdav
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 15806M
    environment:
      - GID=1000
      - PASSWORD=casaos
      - TZ=Europe/Madrid
      - UDI=1000
      - USERNAME=casaos
    image: ugeek/webdav:amd64
    labels:
      icon: https://icon.casaos.io/main/all/webdav.png
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /media/ZimaOS-HD/Media
        target: /media
    network_mode: bridge
    privileged: false
